# Video Scripter

> Video Scripter is an AI script studio for short social video. It turns one brief into a separate, timed, shoot-ready script for each platform: 视频号 (WeChat Channels), 抖音 (Douyin), 小红书 (Xiaohongshu), TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts. It also generates 9:16 storyboard images and video clips from the scene notes.

Video Scripter is a web app. It runs on the user's own machine or on a host such as Vercel, and works with the model provider the user already has. It opens in demo mode with placeholder text until an administrator connects a model.

## Key facts

- Platforms: 6. 视频号, 抖音 and 小红书 scripts are written in Chinese; TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts scripts in English.
- Script lengths in seconds: 视频号 30, 60, 90, 120. 抖音, TikTok and Instagram Reels 15, 30, 45, 60, 90. 小红书 15, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120, 180. YouTube Shorts 30, 45, 60, 90, 180.
- Each script contains: three hook options; a timed scene list where every scene has voiceover, on-screen text, visual, camera and sound notes; a voiceover-only view; and a publishing package (titles, cover text, description, hashtags, pinned comment).
- Script structures: 18. Six general structures: Golden retention; Problem – Agitate – Solve; Story with a turn; Listicle; How-to tutorial; Product showcase. Twelve narration styles, which also set the voice, the pace and the length: Counter-intuitive hit, stop the loss; Saying what they can't; Take-away toolkit; A quiet story; Hard tech, demystified; Consultant whiteboard lecture; Tech news, the insider read; Earnings teardown and business model; Tech explained from first principles (YouTube style); Tech news rundown; Solo podcast; Two-host podcast.
- Narration editor: the narration can be drafted first, pasted in or rewritten beat by beat, and the script is then built around it word for word.
- Visual styles for storyboard images and clips: 74, in eight groups (live action, illustration, 3D and stop motion, graphics and data, presenting and launching, hosts and podcasts, bright and light, era and mood). One style, or two blended. The style is picked from the topic unless the creator picks their own.
- On-screen host: a digital presenter who is the same person in every scene (two for a podcast conversation). The look is written into the script once, a reference portrait is made from it, and scene images are drawn from that portrait where the image model takes a reference.
- Images per scene: 1 to 3. Video clips run 4, 8 or 12 seconds.
- Library: a creator uploads their own documents (.txt, .md, .csv, .docx and more), pictures and clips once. A script is written from the ones picked: documents are read as reference material, and pictures and clips are placed in the scenes that show them, or used as the reference a new scene image is drawn from.
- Model providers: 10 presets (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, DeepSeek, 通义千问 Qwen, 豆包 Doubao, Moonshot Kimi, 智谱 GLM, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, Ollama) plus any OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic-compatible endpoint.
- Export: one .zip per script with the script in Markdown and JSON, the voiceover text, and every generated image and clip, named by scene and timecode.
- Teams: accounts with member and administrator roles, usage recorded per script, per model and per user, and an activity log.
- Privacy: API keys stay on the server. A brief and its reference material are sent only to the model provider the user picked.
- Interface languages: English and Simplified Chinese.

## How it works

1. Write the brief. Only the topic is required; platforms, structure, length, visual style and reference material sharpen the result.
2. Review the script. Each platform opens in its own tab and streams in as it is written.
3. Generate the visuals. A scene's visual and camera notes become a 9:16 image or clip.
4. Export. Download one .zip with the script, voiceover and media.
